# 갈림길

```python run
n = int(input())
if n % 2 == 0:
    print("짝")
```

```python run
try:
    print(int("abc"))
except ValueError as e:
    print("ValueError:", e)
```

```python
if n = 3:
    print(n)
```

```python run
try:
    print(int("7"))
finally:
    print("끝")
```

```python run
for i in range(2):
    print(i)
```
